
tables as individual variables
```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543


```

creating vectors for each column in the previous table. then making it into a nice table using data frame
```{r}
cellIDs <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before <- c(n_before_1, n_before_2)
n_after <- c(n_after_1, n_after_2)

#print(paste(cellID[1], treated[1] ))

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  col1 = c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2),
  col2 = c(treated_1, treated_2),
  col3 = n_before,
  col4 = n_after
  
)

gt(my_data_frame)
my_data_frame[1, "col2"]
```
isolating part of a vector
```{r}
pets <- c("dog", "cat", "horse", "chicken")
third_pet <- pets[3]
print(third_pet)
```
